items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: 1947 I joined Cab Calloway's band, and I took Mushi's place

ctx.x: Yeah, but it was still a kind of a rough thing. Also -- when did you join Cab, because I was in the band when you came in...
Oh, yes. Calloway's band. Well, you know, Cab sent for me to come down there, and it was in 1947. And I joined you in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
